parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

The token is generated by the client and must be unique across different requests. The token can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the VBR instance. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the region ID.

parameters.name: VbrId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the VBR.
